patterns.note: Full-width content sections with generous vertical padding, often featuring a single dominant visual or large, centered text block.
Oversized, stacked sans-serif headings are used to introduce new sections, creating a strong visual hierarchy and dynamic rhythm.
A high-contrast palette of black, white, and light grey is punctuated by a vibrant blue for key calls to action and section backgrounds.
The hero section features a large, fixed text overlay ('MONEY BEYOND BORDERS') that content scrolls *under*, creating a layered depth effect.
Subsequent content sections reveal with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport.
The main navigation bar becomes sticky and gains a solid white background after the initial scroll, maintaining accessibility.
Feature sections often use a grid of three or four cards with icons or small images, each containing a concise title and description.

technique_notes: The hero section uses a large, fixed text element positioned over a video background, with subsequent page content configured to scroll underneath the text, creating a parallax-like depth effect.
The main navigation bar transitions from transparent to a solid white background and becomes sticky at the top of the viewport after a user scrolls past the initial hero section.

Content sections are revealed using scroll-triggered animations (likely CSS keyframes or a JS library like Lottie as hinted) that subtly fade in and slide elements upwards as they enter the user's view.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~4-6x body text) create strong visual impact, contrasted with clear, legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (small radius) are applied consistently to buttons and card elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy spacing is used between major sections and within the hero, creating a sense of openness, while feature grids maintain a balanced density.

standout: The most distinctive element is the oversized, fixed hero text that content scrolls *under*, creating a strong sense of depth and visual hierarchy. This, combined with the bold, stacked typography for section headings, gives the site a powerful and modern aesthetic that feels dynamic without being overly complex.
